bean-tapper-arena.label: S&box game
bean-tapper-arena.status: Verified in the native S&box engine: claim a station, complete a timed round, receive scores and advance to round 2. The refined world scoreboard and camera floor guard were also checked. Physical keyboard/mouse delivery and remote multiplayer remain unverified.
bean-tapper-arena.environment: Windows; Steam and S&box editor (verified with 26.09.22a)
bean-tapper-arena.instructions: Requires Steam and the S&box editor on Windows. Open the game project (.sbproj), load Assets/test.scene, then press F5. In the locally refined build, E uses a nearby station; Space/Enter press an owned station, and Tab toggles the world-scoreboard camera. The latest prepared-project refinements and capture scripts are not published in the source repository yet.

Station in the running native game

bean-tapper-arena.captureNote: Actual running S&box game captured through the native GameEditorSession camera.
